title: LightCarbon LCR017-D | $600 Dream Race Bike?

takeaways.text: The used complete bike cost about ¥4,000 (roughly US$600–700) with a WheelTop electronic groupset, mixed Shimano 105 parts and heavy 30 mm alloy wheels of about 1.6–1.7 kg.
At 170 cm he chose the size 49; he notes the 74.5° seat angle and 0 mm-offset seatpost, and finds the drop aggressive.
The seller had sawn a bulge off the integrated-bar spacer to make the bar sit correctly, and a Di2 exit plug was missing; the bar flares to about 45 cm at the drops.

disclosure: The presenter bought the bike second-hand in China; he is sponsored by an unrelated clothing brand.
summary: First look at a second-hand size-49 LCR017-D complete bike bought in Beijing, with WheelTop electronic shifting; no outdoor ride yet.
